[EN] If I didn't know better, I'd think these events were all being coordinated. Uprisings near Popolion, strange creatures around the Lake of Tears, and madness at the Eldritch Academy.

Go on, tell me I'm being paranoid.
[ES] Si no lo supiera mejor, pensaría que todos estos eventos están siendo coordinados. Levantamientos cerca de Popolion, extrañas criaturas alrededor de Lake of Tears y locura en la Eldritch Academy.

Vamos, dime que estoy siendo paranoico.
